title: 第23章 豪车美女三千五百万第24章 收购百年药材
lines: 唐明无视周围人怪异的目光，自顾自的看书复习。
唰！唰！唰！
书本翻动的声音不绝于耳。
一目十行，过目不忘。
“修为提升，神魂精神力也随之提升，看书效率比以前提高了好几倍。”
唐明眼眸中闪烁着淡淡青芒。
经过这几天的看书，他基本上把课本上的内容熟记于心，就算现在去高考，也能考出很惊人的成绩。
这就是神魂力的恐怖作用。
很快，到了放学时间。
唐明刚走出校门，就被二十几个魁梧的男子给堵住了。
“小子，你就是唐明？”
一名眉角留有刀疤的男子，打量唐明几眼道：“就是你把樊晨废掉了？”
唐明淡淡道：“是我。”
“呵呵，心态倒是很好。”
刀疤脸语气变得森然起来：“樊晨是我小弟，你把他废了，我这做大哥的很没有面子啊。”
“你说，这件事如何解决？”
伴随着他的话语，周围大汉再次逼近一步。
这些人都是货真价实的黑社会，尤其是为首的刀疤脸，更是附近街道的扛把子，行事霸道张狂。
周围的学生见此，面色剧变纷纷绕路。
拥堵的学校门口，很快就出现一个空挡区域，没人敢过来触霉头。
“你想要交代？”
唐明眉头一挑，玩味般的看向刀疤脸：“就怕我给你的交代，你承受不起。”
“草，怎么和刀哥说话的？”
一名黄毛小弟骂骂咧咧，反手就是一巴掌抡过来。
唐明眼中迸出寒芒，探手抓住对方的手掌握在手心，陡然加大力量。
咔嚓！
咔嚓！
指骨寸寸断裂。
“啊！”黄毛小弟疼得冷汗直流，嚎叫不已。
其他同伴见状就要上前帮忙，甚至有人把手伸进口袋握紧武器。
“等等。”
刀疤脸挥手制止手下人的举动，盯着唐明的动作，有些阴晴不定。
他自幼就在江湖上浪迹，先不说战力如何，至少眼力阅历很毒辣，在道上见过很多不显山不露水的强者。
面前这个少年虽然年轻，可一出手就把小弟的指骨捏断，单凭这份臂力，他们这边没有一个人能够做到。
刀疤微眯着眼睛，缓缓道：“小兄弟劲道很大，以前练过？”
“你猜。”
唐明手劲再度发力。
黄毛疼得晕死过去，右掌五指软绵绵的催下来，看起来很是恐怖。
“你这就有有些不厚道了吧？”
刀疤脸色有些难看：“废了樊晨，又断去黄毛一只手，要是传出去我刀疤还怎么混？”
“爱怎么混就怎么混。”
唐明满脸不耐烦：“我没时间和你们浪费要打就打，不打就滚远点！”
content_en:
Tang Ming ignored the weird looks from the people around him and focused on reading and reviewing.
Uh-huh! Uh-huh! Uh-huh!
The sound of books turning is endless.
One glance and ten lines, a photographic memory.
"With the improvement of cultivation level, the spiritual power of the soul will also increase, and the efficiency of reading books will be improved several times compared with before."
Tang Ming's eyes flashed with a faint green light.
After these few days of reading, he has basically memorized the contents of the textbook. Even if he takes the college entrance examination now, he can still get amazing results.
This is the terrifying effect of divine soul power.
Soon, it was time for school to end.
As soon as Tang Ming walked out of the school gate, he was blocked by more than twenty burly men.
"Boy, are you Tang Ming?"
A man with a scar on the corner of his eyebrow looked at Tang Ming and said, "You were the one who killed Fan Chen?"
Tang Ming said calmly: "It's me."
"Haha, I'm in a good mood."
Scarface's tone became serious: "Fan Chen is my younger brother. If you destroy him, I, as the elder brother, will have no face."
"Tell me, how to solve this matter?"
Following his words, the big men around him took a step closer again.
These people are real gangsters, especially the leader, Scarface, who is the leader of the nearby streets and behaves domineeringly and arrogantly.
Seeing this, the surrounding students' expressions changed dramatically and they all took a detour.
In front of the crowded school, a vacant area soon appeared, and no one dared to come and cause trouble.
"You want to explain?"
Tang Ming raised his eyebrows and looked at Scarface playfully: "I'm afraid you won't be able to bear the explanation I gave you."
"Hey, why are you talking to Brother Dao?"
A yellow-haired boy cursed and slapped him with his backhand.
Tang Ming's eyes flashed with cold light, he reached out and grabbed the opponent's hand, holding it in his hand, and suddenly increased his strength.
Click!
Click!
The finger bones were broken every inch.
"Ah!" The yellow-haired boy was so painful that he was sweating and howling.
When other companions saw this, they stepped forward to help. Some even reached into their pockets and grasped their weapons.
"Wait."
Scarface waved his hand to stop his men's actions, staring at Tang Ming's movements with some uncertainty.
He has been wandering around the world since he was a child. Not to mention his combat prowess, at least his eyesight and experience are ruthless. He has seen many inconspicuous and strong men on the road.
Although the boy in front of him was young, he could crush his younger brother's finger bones with one strike. No one on their side could do it with this arm strength alone.
Scar narrowed his eyes slightly and said slowly: "Little brother is very strong, have you practiced before?"
"Guess."
Tang Ming used his strength again.
"Click——"
Huang Mao fainted from the pain, and the five fingers of his right palm came down softly, looking very scary.
"Are you being a little unkind?"
Scar's face looked a little ugly: "I've crippled Fan Chen and cut off one of Huang Mao's hands. How can I, Scar, survive if word gets out?"
"Fuck around as much as you like."
Tang Ming's face was full of impatience: "I don't have time to waste with you. If you want to fight, fight. If you don't want to fight, get away!"
